'''Histrory of faust:'''

Faust is a 1v1 duel map by {{player|kwon|flag=de}} and was first played in the Blitzkrieg Cup #2. The name Faust comes from an old German drama by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe from the year 1808 and is considered one of the most significant and frequently quoted works of German literature. The tragedy revolves around the scholar Dr. Heinrich Faust, who, after a crisis of meaning, makes a pact with Mephisto, who in return for his soul promises him fulfillment and happiness. As the drama progresses, Faust becomes too greedy, and his insatiable desire for fulfillment cannot be satisfied, leading him to lose everything in the end. The story of Faust inspired the mapper to create a new gameplay style. In the map Faust, players have the ability to eliminate their opponent at the right moment with the press of a button. This gameplay requires a highly strategic approach, avoiding becoming too greedy for major items.
